report: User cast the ordinary Enslave Demon icon on a subsequent NPC after leaving the New Blood cage; worldserver crashed.

diagnosis.cause: The high-level instanced-creature restriction dereferenced GetOwner()->IsPlayer() without checking for a null owner. Charming sets a charmer, not an owner; ordinary world NPCs can therefore reach this branch ownerless.
diagnosis.symbolEvidence: Re-linked the retained objects/libraries into a diagnostic executable with /INCREMENTAL /OPT:NOREF /OPT:NOICF and a map. Its complete .text section is byte-identical to the crashing executable (42613248 bytes). The old runtime map dated September 23 was not used.

repair: Treat an absent owner as not player-owned while preserving the existing level, instance and controllable-guardian restrictions. No quest data or character state changes.
